summary: - _c) pass such other and further order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the present case and in the interest of justice._ 5. Due to certain unavoidable circumstances, the Petitioner submitted Petition No. 228/MP/2022, in which the Commission, through its order dated 06.12.2023, granted an extension to the Petitioner until 31.03.2024, for fulfilling the requirements of the Independent and Managing Director. The relevant paragraph 30 of the order dated 06.12.2023 is presented below for consideration: _“30. In view of the submissions as stated above, we are inclined to invoke our power to relax. In the exercise of the powers under Regulation 56 of PMR 2021, the Commission hereby grants the Petitioner time up to 31.03.2024 to align its requirement of the appointment of a Managing Director and alignment of the number of Independent Directors as per the requirement under Regulation 17 of PMR 2021.”_ 6. The petitioner submitted that in compliance with the order in petition 228/MP/2022, they have undertaken few changes in the Directorship and Managerial positions. The said changes are reflected below: 10. The Petitioner also submitted that the composition of the Board has been altered, as the nominee Directors of the promoter(s) were also changed a few times during previous years, and due to the changes, a delay occurred in the process of finalisation of candidates for the positions of Managing Director and Independent Directors, as the discussions on these critical issues could not be held continuously and were postponed. 14. The Petitioner has already taken the following steps for the selection of the Independent Director and the Managing Director: _The Commission may in appropriate case and for reasons to be recorded in writing relax any provisions of this regulation”_ 19. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission admitted the petition and issued notice to the respondents. The Commission also gave the opportunity to the respondents to file their reply within a week. Subject to the above, the Commission reserved the matter for order. 20. The order in the matter which was reserved on 08.05.2024 could not be issued as the Members of the Commission who formed part of the Coram, demitted office. Accordingly, the matter was re-listed for hearing. 22. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner further submitted that insofar as the appointment of Managing Director is concerned, the Petitioner is in the process of finalizing suitable candidates for the said post, and in this regard, the first round of interviews has also been conducted. 23. In response to the specific query of the commission, learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner is expecting the finalization of a suitable candidate for the post of Managing Director within three months and requested to adjourn the matter for a period of three months. Considering the submissions made by the Petitioner, the commission adjourned the matter and directed it to be listed after three months to examine the progress made by the Petitioner in the appointment of the Managing Director. 25. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission, while granting a final opportunity, mandated the Petitioner to finalize the appointment of the Independent Director and Managing Director within two months from the issuance of the ROP failing which the Petitioner will be liable to pay the appropriate penalty for non-compliance with the Commission's directions. 26. The Commission directed the Petitioner to submit on an affidavit within two weeks, the details of the methodology used, along with information regarding applicants for the selection and appointment of the Independent Director and Managing Director. 27. In compliance with the above direction, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 14.01.2025 has submitted that they have taken the following steps for the 28. The Petitioner has already filed Petition No. 291/RC/2024 on 02.08.2024, wherein the Petitioner has submitted two names for the vacancy of Independent Director for approval of the Commission. 31. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission directed the Petitioner to file an affidavit within 3 days indicating the precise date by which the Petitioner shall appoint the Managing Director. The Commission expressed its displeasure at this non-compliance with the direction of the Commission and directed the Petitioner to appoint a Managing Director at a precise date agreed by the Commission, failing which the Petitioner will be liable to pay the penalty for non-compliance with the direction of the Commission. 32. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner had filed an affidavit dated 07.03.2025 in compliance with the Commission’s directions, vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 04.03.2025. A detailed offer letter was issued on 10.02.2025 to the selected candidate, Mr. Harish Saran, for the position of Managing Director. The selection process was in accordance with the Commission's order dated 12.05.2021, amended Articles of Association, and Companies Act 2013. 34. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission reserved the matter for order. “ _PTC shall not at any point of time have veto rights in the matters relating to day to day functioning of the Petitioner as per items 1, 4, 5, 8, 9, 13, 14 and 16 of Schedule 3 of the SHA and decisive voting rights with regards to any change in senior management including key management employees as per item 17 of the Schedule 3 of the SHA. For this purpose, necessary amendments in the SHA shall be effected by the Petitioner. Further, consequential changes as required shall also be incorporated in Rules, Bye-Laws, Business Rules, and other such documents by the Petitioner."_
title: Petition under Section 66 of the Electricity Act read with Regulation 17(12), 54, 55, and 56 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Power Market) Regulations, 2021 seeking additional time period for meeting the compliances as set out under Regulation 17 of the said Regulations.
